title: How many of Zelvora cell lot ZC2638's 7,200 Model K packs Kalvenhorst Systeme reserves for at release: the packs expected to fall below 80 per cent of rated capacity within the 600-cycle warranty
subdomain: bayesian-modeling-posterior-inference (the posterior predictive for the members of new groups: the chance that the weakest of a pack's three cells from one new formation tray falls below the warranty line, under the between-tray variance of the release model's error)
prompt_shape: single-figure: the reserve in packs, with two 2025-26 tables (the four repair partners' capacity replacements under the warranty and their average cost, the capacity replacements carried out each month) and one chart
